vi_hint: Hàng hoá hạ đẳng; hàng hoá thứ cấp.

glosses: Someone who inflates.

A cause of inflation.

The amount of time it takes for the government or the central bank to respond to a shock in the economy.
The quality of being integrable (having an antidifference or antiderivative).
The recoverability of preferences from a Walrasian demand function.
The real value of something, calculated with regard to an inherent, objective measure, which may not take into account its market value or face value.
Non-relational or non-instrumental value, or the value something has in itself, for its own sake, or as such.
A metaphor for the principle that in a free market, an individual pursuing his own self-interest also tends to promote the good of his community as a whole.

Such that no Kaldor-Hicks improvement is possible.

A kind of diagram that plots aggregate income against planned total spending or aggregate expenditure.
The market consisting of the supply of unemployed workers in relation to the demand for them.
The theory, usually associated with Marxian economics, that freely reproducible goods obtain their value from socially necessary human labor time.
